response.sql: WITH op AS (SELECT crewref, COUNT(*) AS scan_cnt, AVG(gbsize * 1.0 / NULLIF(spanmin, 0)) AS avg_rate FROM scans GROUP BY crewref HAVING AVG(gbsize * 1.0 / NULLIF(spanmin, 0)) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS g FROM op) SELECT AVG(op.scan_cnt * 1.0) AS avg_scans, AVG(op.avg_rate) AS avg_gb_per_min, AVG(op.avg_rate - overall.g) AS avg_excess FROM op CROSS JOIN overall WHERE op.avg_rate > overall.g
